We want to run a festival on 20 August 2026 for about 30,000 people, with a shade-structure
budget of €250,000. The vibe is a bit hard to pin down — we keep saying we want it to feel
"green and grounded", lots of planting, timber, leaves and an earthy, organic mood that
melts into the landscape. Pick whichever single theme from your fixed list fits that
feeling best.
